landmine.name: Landmine attachment or a barbell end wedged in a corner

rack.name: Squat rack or power rack with safety pins

calf_raise_machine.name: Standing or seated calf raise machine

hip_thrust_machine.name: Hip thrust or glute bridge machine

sliders.name: Floor sliders or a towel on a smooth floor

weight_vest.name: Weight vest, or a dip belt with plates

tags.deep_knee_flexion: Loads the knee in deep bending (deep squats, lunges)
tags.spinal_loading: Heavy load travels through the spine (bar on back, heavy pulls)
tags.wrist_extension_load: Body weight or load rests on bent-back wrists
tags.spinal_flexion: Repeated rounding of the spine under load (crunch-type movements)
tags.breath_hold_max: Usually lifted heavy with a held breath (heavy barbell squats, deadlifts, presses, leg press) (SAF-010)
tags.isometric_heavy: A long or heavy hold (heavy carries, long-lever planks, hanging) (SAF-010)
tags.loaded_spinal_rotation: Twisting the trunk against a load (chops, lifts, rotational throws) (SAF-010)
tags.deep_hip_flexion: Deep hip bending (deep squats, knee-to-chest positions) (SAF-010, MOB-004 range limits)
tags.head_down: Head below the heart (pike and feet-up push-ups, forward folds) (SAF-010)
tags.supine_lying: Lying flat on the back (bench press, bridges, dead bugs) (SAF-010)
tags.prone_lying: Lying face down or with the belly on a pad (chest-supported rows, back extensions) (SAF-010)
tags.high_fall_risk: Balance-demanding or easy to fall from (single-leg hinges, step-ups, jumps, standing rollouts) (SAF-010)
tags.unsupported_single_leg: Standing on one leg without a hand on a support (SAF-010)
tags.contact: Contact with other people or objects at speed; used for activities the user adds (SAF-010)
tags.olympic_lift: Olympic lifts and their variations; none in the built-in library (SAF-010)
tags.uneven_surface_running: Running on trails or uneven ground; used for activities the user adds (SAF-010)
tags.overhead_heavy: An external load pressed or held overhead (SAF-010)

VERTICAL_PUSH.CABLE: Overhead cable presses are awkward on most cable columns; machine, dumbbell, kettlebell and landmine presses cover the pattern.

VERTICAL_PULL.BARBELL: No free-weight vertical pull exists; pull-up bar, pulldown and assisted machine cover the pattern.
VERTICAL_PULL.DUMBBELL: No free-weight vertical pull exists; covered by pulldown, pull-up and band options.
VERTICAL_PULL.KETTLEBELL: No free-weight vertical pull exists; covered by pulldown, pull-up and band options.

LOADED_CARRY.CABLE: Carries need a held load you can walk with.
LOADED_CARRY.MACHINE: Carries need a held load you can walk with.
LOADED_CARRY.BODYWEIGHT: Carries need an external load; crawls (anti-extension) are the bodyweight substitute.

ROTATION.MACHINE: Rotation is trained with cables, a landmine or a medicine ball.
ROTATION.BODYWEIGHT: Controlled rotation needs resistance; band chops are the no-equipment option.

ANTI_EXTENSION.KETTLEBELL: Covered by bodyweight progressions and the weighted dead bug with a dumbbell.
ANTI_EXTENSION.CABLE: Covered by bodyweight progressions, ab wheel and barbell rollout.
ANTI_EXTENSION.MACHINE: Covered by bodyweight progressions, ab wheel and barbell rollout.

ANTI_ROTATION.BARBELL: Covered by cable and band Pallof presses, bird dog and renegade row.
ANTI_ROTATION.KETTLEBELL: Covered by cable and band Pallof presses, bird dog and renegade row.
ANTI_ROTATION.MACHINE: Covered by cable and band Pallof presses.

ANTI_LATERAL_FLEXION.BARBELL: Covered by side planks and dumbbell or kettlebell suitcase carries.
ANTI_LATERAL_FLEXION.CABLE: Covered by side planks and suitcase carries.
ANTI_LATERAL_FLEXION.MACHINE: Covered by side planks and suitcase carries.
